title: Playing with Arnold Metoyer at Tom Anderson's, and wife in the four-piece band
summary: Francis played with Metoyer; Armstrong replaced him c.1919 at Tom Anderson's. The band was four pieces including his wife Edna Mitchell on piano, who died in 1942. He corrects dates in Charter's book.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Arnold Matoie. You heard of him? Yes. We talked to his widow and his daughter. I played with him. You played with him, Matoie. When was that?

When he left, Lloyd took his place around 1919. Is that at Com Anderson's? Yeah, right there. There on the Ramparts. Right way up. What you call him? Right there. Long time. The Woolworths is now. Right with Wade. We played there a long time. He was good, I'm telling you. But he liked.
Who else was in the band? Who else was in the band when you played? When I know him? Yes, what's on the band?

I know him, my wife, Paul and Paul Dominguez. Oh, is it violin? Yeah. It was four of us, yeah. Your wife played piano? Yeah, she died in my field. She was good. Her name was Edna Mitchell, I went by the name. She's in this book too.

Yes, I've heard of her. When did she die, by the way? What year was that about? 1942. 1942. December 10, yeah. Soon be 20 years now. Long time. Do you remember how we think of it? If you could tell us a little bit about her life. It's in this book, yeah. All them bands she played. Was she born right here too? Right here, she was good. Let me see what I can find it.

You might check on that and be sure it's all accurate. Oh yeah. They got plenty of things in this book that's wrong too. I know it. I know it. That's why I thought we better check on anything. He left here playing. I wrote it down. I got a fucking fine. He left here playing with me. I told him that he left here in 1922, but they said 23. You see why I know it? He said my wife was about to be a mother. He supposed to christendom baby. And she was born in August, 22, and left about June or July with Joe Oliver.
